    Why Regular Laxatives FAIL
    When You're on a GLP-1

    GLP-1 medications slow your entire digestive system — that's how they reduce appetite and help you lose weight.

     

    But food sits longer in your stomach (causing fermentation and those awful sulphur burps) and waste moves slower through your intestines (hello, constipation).

    Why? Because big pharmaceutical companies haven't caught up.

    They're selling you the same solutions designed for regular constipation. Miralax adds BULK to stool. But if your gut isn't moving, adding more bulk makes things worse — like adding more cars to a traffic jam.

     

    Stimulant laxatives force contractions but work AGAINST the slowdown, causing cramping, urgency, and "disaster pants."

    At GLP-1 SOS, we believe the solution has to work WITH the slowdown — not against it.

    By using gentle osmotic magnesium to draw water in naturally, ginger root to help your stomach empty properly, and targeted nutrients to replace what you're missing from eating less — we're giving your body exactly what it needs.

     

    We're not fighting your medication. We're supporting your body through it.*

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Does this replace my regular vitamins?

    GLP-1 SOS contains 14 active ingredients including key vitamins and minerals (B12, B6, Iron, Zinc, Vitamin D3, Folate, Biotin, and Magnesium). While it covers many of the nutrients GLP-1 users are commonly deficient in, it's designed as targeted side effect support. Consult your healthcare provider about your complete supplement routine.

    How quickly will I notice results?

    Most women report sulphur burps reducing within 48 hours. Comfortable bowel movements typically begin within 3-5 days. Energy and mental clarity improvements are usually noticed within 2-3 weeks. Individual results may vary.*

    Will this cause cramping or urgency?

    No. GLP-1 SOS uses gentle osmotic magnesium — not harsh stimulant laxatives. It draws water into your intestines naturally. No cramping, no urgency, no "disaster pants."*

    Can I take this with my GLP-1 medication?

    GLP-1 SOS is a dietary supplement containing vitamins, minerals, herbs, and probiotics. It's designed to complement GLP-1 medications. However, always consult your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement, especially if you take prescription medications.

    What makes this different from Miralax or fiber supplements?

    Miralax and fiber add BULK to stool. But GLP-1 medications slow gut motility — so adding bulk to a system that isn't moving makes things worse. GLP-1 SOS uses gentle osmotic magnesium to draw water in naturally, working WITH your slowed system — not against it.*

    Is this third-party tested?

    Yes. Every batch of GLP-1 SOS is manufactured in an FDA-registered, GMP-certified facility in the USA and undergoes third-party testing for purity and potency.

    What are the capsules made of?

    Clear HPMC vegetable capsules. They're transparent so you can actually see the herbs inside. No gelatin, no artificial colors, no mystery ingredients.

    What if it doesn't work for me?

    We offer a 60-Day Money-Back Guarantee. No questions asked. If you're not satisfied for any reason, contact us for a full refund.
